records.unit_title: BUB1B monoallelic germline variants and prostate-cancer predisposition
records.unit_text_serialization: JATS itertext with whitespace collapsed, then LF; selected section or inclusive paragraph-ID range
records.selection_scope: Targeted recovery of six complete abstracts containing literal BUB1B/BUBR1 mentions in five previously unread conference collections; remaining collection content unread.
records.model: Patient-carrier and cell-based BUB1B variant characterization
records.note: A monoallelic Glu391 deletion is associated with reduced mitotic BubR1, taxol-resistant proliferation, early mitotic exit and chromosome instability. This is disease/variant evidence, not drug rescue.
records.uncertainty: Conference abstract; no implemented restorative drug or MVA muscle outcome. Variant architecture differs from the proposed biallelic case.

records.unit_title: Curcumin in a HER2-transformed breast-epithelial model
records.unit_text_serialization: JATS itertext with whitespace collapsed, then LF; selected section or inclusive paragraph-ID range
records.selection_scope: Targeted recovery of six complete abstracts containing literal BUB1B/BUBR1 mentions in five previously unread conference collections; remaining collection content unread.
records.model: HER2-transformed 184B5/HER and parental breast epithelial cultures
records.note: The abstract reports concentration-dependent cytostasis/apoptosis and lower BubR1 transcript during curcumin exposure; parental cells respond differently. This is a tumor-cell intervention, not a restore-the-protein result.
records.uncertainty: Conference abstract only; replication, normal-tissue window and MVA relevance are unresolved. BubR1 is not among the listed western-validated proteins; do not infer its protein decrease.

records.model: 38 paired pediatric leukemia cases, with multi-omics in 13 paired PDX models
records.note: BUB1B is named within one hypermutator-associated mutation pattern; relapse subtypes differ in clonal evolution and regulatory programs.
records.uncertainty: Treatment-trial enrollment is background, not evidence that any named drug rescues BUB1B deficiency. No comparative drug benefit is measured here. Complete textual abstract only; embedded image F9 has not been inspected.

records.unit_title: DHMMF targets RACK1 in liver-cancer cells

administered_agents.name: DHMMF
administered_agents.role: purified flavonoid; mitotic disruption and metabolic effects

records.note: Actual DHMMF raises phospho-BubR1 while inducing spindle defects and DNA damage, suppressing viability and lipid-related signals. Binding experiments and RACK1 knockdown support a target contribution, not beneficial BUB1B rescue.
records.uncertainty: No MVA model, completed faithful divisions, normal-tissue window or muscle benefit; prior animal efficacy is cited rather than remeasured here. See separate source qualification.
